title: Energy Department gives TerraPower $80M to start Natrium reactor demo

sources.quote: DOE is awarding TerraPower LLC (Bellevue, Washington) and X-energy (Rockville, Maryland) $80 million each in initial funding to build two advanced nuclear reactors that can be operational within seven years.
The Department will invest a total of $3.2 billion over seven years, subject to the availability of future appropriations, with our industry partners providing matching funds.

explain: The Energy Department granted TerraPower $80 million in first-year money to build a demonstration Natrium advanced reactor. DOE said it would put up to $3.2 billion over seven years into this and X-energy's project combined, depending on future budgets.
